;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Taliban]] insurgents attacked a checkpoint in the western province of [[Afghanistan]] of [[Herat]] killing 9 and injuring 6 the [[militants]] suffered 10 losses as well. [https://www.voanews.com/a/killed-in-attack-on-checkpoint-in-western-afghanistan/4563656.html (VOA)]
;Business and economy
*The [[World Trade Center–Cortlandt (IRT Broadway–Seventh Avenue Line)|WTC–Cortlandt]] [[New York City Subway|subway]] station in lower [[Manhattan]] opens for the first time since being destroyed in the [[September 11 attacks]] in 2001. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/09/08/nyregion/cortlandt-street-subway-station-911.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi earthquake]]
**The death toll from the [[earthquake]] in [[Hokkaido]], [[Japan]], rises to 39. More people remain missing. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2018/09/09/national/death-toll-hokkaido-earthquake-rises-37/#.W5T7XnPOM0M (''The Japan Times'')] 
*A [[pneumonia]] outbreak in [[Brescia]] and [[Mantova]], [[Italy]], infects at least 150 people. The deaths of two other people are suspected connected to the disease. The cause is a suspected bacterium in the water. [https://brescia.corriere.it/notizie/cronaca/18_settembre_07/montichiari-71-casi-polmonite-allertati-medici-famiglia-pediatri-7224d164-b2c8-11e8-af77-790d0c049f1d.shtml (''Corriere della Sera'')]
*15 people died and 13 were injured when a truck carrying potatoes crashed into five vehicles in [[Mbeya]], [[Tanzania]]. [http://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/news/ea/Tanzania-road-crash-Mbeya/4552908-4749710-s9k79ez/index.html (The East African)]
*At least 15 people are killed and 25 others wounded when a passenger bus collides with a truck in [[Kandahar]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.tolonews.com/afghanistan/traffic-accident-kandahar-leaves-25-dead (TOLONews)]
*A bus plunges into a ravine in [[Sukabumi]], [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]], resulting in 21 deaths. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/21-killed-indonesia-bus-plunges-ravine-57691325 (ABC News)]
*The [[Prime Minister of Abkhazia]] [[Gennadi Gagulia]] dies in a car accident in [[Abkhazia]] after returning from a trip to [[Syria]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/georgia-breakaway-abkhazia-prime-minister-dies-in-car-accident/29479196.html (RFE/RL)] [http://tass.com/emergencies/1020630 (TASS)]

;Health and environment
*[[2018 Middle East respiratory syndrome outbreak]]
**A [[South Korea]]n man is diagnosed with the potentially deadly [[Middle East respiratory syndrome|MERS virus]] and is being treated at a hospital in [[Seoul]], the first such case in three years. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-health-mers/south-korean-man-infected-by-mers-virus-first-case-in-three-years-idUSKCN1LO0EU (Reuters)]
*The [[Public Health England]] reports the [[United Kingdom]]'s first ever case of [[monkeypox]] in a [[Nigerians|Nigerian]] national staying at a naval base in [[Cornwall]]. The patient is being treated at the [[Royal Free Hospital]] in [[London]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/sep/08/first-ever-case-of-monkeypox-recorded-in-the-uk (''The Guardian'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Human rights in Iran]]
**[[Judicial system of Iran|Iran's judiciary]] executes three [[Kurds in Iran|Iranian Kurdish]] prisoners, including [[Ramin Panahi]], for terrorism offences. Two [[United Nations]] [[United Nations special rapporteur|special rapporteurs]] condemn the executions and [[Amnesty International]] alleges their trials were unfair, due to the denial of legal counsel and confessions obtained through torture. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-rights-executions/iran-executes-three-kurdish-prisoners-accused-of-militant-attacks-idUSKCN1LO0PA (Reuters)]
*[[Human rights in Egypt]]
**A court in Egypt sentences 75 people to death for participating in a pro-[[Mohamed Morsi|Morsi]] [[2012–13 Egyptian protests|sit-in protest in a Cairo suburb in 2013]]. The [[August 2013 Rabaa massacre|breakup of that protest at Rabaa Square]] by Egyptian authorities resulted in over 600 deaths. Of the 739 defendants, [[Muslim Brotherhood]] leader [[Mohamed Badie]] and 46 others are sentenced to life in prison, 374 receive 15-year jail terms, 22 are sentenced to 10 years and 215 people, including [[Mahmoud Abu Zeid]] (Shawkan), to five years in jail. [https://www.france24.com/en/20180908-egypt-court-sentence-photographer-2013-protest-mohamed-badie-morsi-abu-zaid (France 24)] [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/world/egypt-sentences-75-islamist-demonstrators-to-death-over-morsi-protest-a3930766.html (''The Evening Standard'')]
